export type DaemonRouteMethod = "GET" | "POST" | "PUT" | "DELETE" | "ANY" | "WS";
export interface DaemonRoute {
    method: DaemonRouteMethod;
    path: string;
    feature?: DaemonFeature;
    summary: string;
}

    id: number;

export type ContextStrategy = "full" | "lean" | "micro";
export type ActionEffect = "read" | "mutate" | "unknown";
export type ActionEffectSource = "declared" | "inferred";
export interface ElicitParams {
    message: string;
    _meta?: Record<string, unknown>;
    requestedSchema: {
        type: "object";
        properties: Record<string, ElicitPrimitiveSchema>;
        required?: string[];
    };
}
export type ElicitPrimitiveSchema = {
    type: "string";
    title?: string;
    description?: string;
    enum?: string[];
    enumNames?: string[];
    default?: string;
} | {
    type: "number" | "integer";
    title?: string;
    description?: string;
    default?: number;
} | {
    type: "boolean";
    title?: string;
    description?: string;
    default?: boolean;
} | (ElicitMultiSelectBase & {
    items: {
        type: "string";
        enum: string[];
    };
}) | (ElicitMultiSelectBase & {
    items: {
        anyOf: Array<{
            const: string;
            title: string;
        }>;
    };
});
interface ElicitMultiSelectBase {
    type: "array";
    title?: string;
    description?: string;
    minItems?: number;
    maxItems?: number;
    default?: string[];
}
export interface ElicitResult {
    action: "accept" | "decline" | "cancel";
    content?: Record<string, string | number | boolean | string[]>;
}
export interface ModelToolCall {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    arguments: Record<string, unknown>;
}
export interface ModelMessage {
    role: "system" | "user" | "assistant" | "tool";
    content: string;
    toolCalls?: ModelToolCall[];
    toolCallId?: string;
    name?: string;
}
export interface ModelToolDefinition {
    name: string;
    description?: string;
    parameters: Record<string, unknown>;
}
export interface ModelRequest {
    system?: string;
    prompt?: string;
    messages?: ModelMessage[];
    model?: string;
    maxTokens?: number;
    temperature?: number;
    stop?: string[];
    schema?: Record<string, unknown>;
    tools?: ModelToolDefinition[];
    toolChoice?: "auto" | "none" | "required" | {
        name: string;
    };
    signal?: AbortSignal;
}
export interface ModelResponse {
    text: string;
    parsed?: unknown;
    toolCalls?: ModelToolCall[];
    finishReason?: "stop" | "tool_use" | "length" | (string & {});
    usage?: {
        inputTokens?: number;
        outputTokens?: number;
    };
    model?: string;
}
export interface ModelProvider {
    complete(req: ModelRequest): Promise<ModelResponse>;
}
export type DialogBlock = {
    type: "paragraph";
    text: string;
} | {
    type: "table";
    columns: string[];
    rows: string[][];
    checked?: Array<boolean | null>;
    items?: Array<number | null>;
};
export interface DialogPromptRequest extends ElicitParams {
    dialog: {
        editor: string;
        title: string;
        message: string;
        buttons: string[];
        items?: Array<{
            index: number;
            label: string;
            cells: string[];
            checked: boolean;
        }>;
        blocks?: DialogBlock[];
        native?: {
            hwnd: string;
            pid: number;
            kind: "gpu-crash" | "assert" | "ensure" | "missing-modules" | "crash" | "message";
            summary: string;
            details?: string[];
        };
        subject: string;
        minHumanMs: number;
    };
}
export type DialogPromptResult = ElicitResult | {
    action: "delegate";
};
export type DialogPromptFn = (request: DialogPromptRequest) => Promise<DialogPromptResult>;
export interface DialogEventData {
    editor: string;
    title: string;
    message: string;
    buttons: string[];
    items?: Array<{
        index: number;
        label: string;
        cells: string[];
        checked: boolean;
    }>;
    blocks?: DialogBlock[];
    mode?: "auto" | "interactive" | "defer";
    button?: string;
    via?: "prompt" | "action" | "person";
    native?: NativeDialogInfo;
}
export interface NativeDialogInfo {
    hwnd: string;
    pid: number;
    kind: "gpu-crash" | "assert" | "ensure" | "missing-modules" | "crash" | "message";
    summary: string;
    details?: string[];
}

}

    pressed: boolean;
    closed: boolean;

    error?: string;
}

export type InstallKind = "source" | "binary";
export interface InstallMarker {
    kind: InstallKind;
    engine: string | null;
    platform: string | null;
    version: string | null;
}
export interface PendingBuild {
    version: string;
    at: string;
    reason: string;
    failed?: {
        at: string;
        message: string;
    };
}
export interface InstallBridgeStatus {
    deployed: boolean;
    pluginDir: string | null;
    installKind: InstallKind | null;
    enabledInUproject: boolean;
    packagedVersion: string | null;
    installedVersion: string | null;
    versionMatch: boolean | null;
    compiled: boolean;
    binaryPath?: string;
    stale: boolean;
    pendingBuild: PendingBuild | null;
}
export interface ToolchainReport {
    present: boolean;
    name: string | null;
    detail?: string;
    probed: string[];
    fix?: string;
}
export interface EngineStatus {
    resolved: boolean;
    root: string | null;
    source: string | null;
    buildTool: string | null;
}
export interface InstallProblem {
    code: "no_engine" | "no_toolchain" | "bridge_not_deployed" | "bridge_not_enabled" | "bridge_never_compiled" | "bridge_build_stale" | "bridge_version_mismatch";
    what: string;
    fix: string;
}
export interface ClientStatus {

}
export interface StatusReport {
    version: string;
    node: {
        version: string;
        execPath: string;
    };
    project: {
        path: string;
        name: string;
        engine: string | null;
        engineAssociation: string | null;
    };
    plugin: InstallBridgeStatus & {
        dirSource: "instance-record" | "default" | "scan" | null;
        marker: InstallMarker | null;
    };
    editor: {
        running: boolean;
        instances: Array<{
            pid: number;
            port: number;
            state: string | null;
            alive: boolean;
            startedAt: string | null;
        }>;
    };
    toolchain: ToolchainReport;
    engine: EngineStatus;
    config: {
        path: string;
        exists: boolean;
    };
    clients: ClientStatus[];
    ok: boolean;
    problems: InstallProblem[];
    nextSteps: string[];
}
export declare const MACHINE_REPORT_VERSION = 1;
export interface MachineDaemon {
    key: string;
    projectRoot: string;
    uproject: string | null;
    pid: number;
    port: number;
    version: string;
    startedAt: string;
    discovery: string;
    log: string;
}
export interface MachineProject {
    name: string;
    uproject: string;
    dir: string;
    key: string;
    source: "recent" | "added";
    lastOpened: string | null;
    engine: {
        association: string | null;
        version: string | null;
    };
    editor: {
        running: boolean;
        pids: number[];
    };
    ueMcp: {
        setUp: boolean;
        bridge: {
            version: string;
            kind: "source" | "binary" | null;
        } | null;
        config: boolean;
    };
    extensions: Record<string, string>;
    plugins: Array<{
        name: string;
        version: string | null;
    }>;
    daemon: {
        discovery: string;
        log: string;
        running: MachineDaemon | null;
    };
}
export interface MachineReport {
    version: typeof MACHINE_REPORT_VERSION;
    ueMcp: string;
    daemonDir: string;
    projects: MachineProject[];
    daemons: MachineDaemon[];
}
export type CheckpointTrigger = "client" | "restore-before" | "restore-after";
export type ChangeStatus = "added" | "modified" | "deleted";
export type ChangeKind = "package" | "config" | "source" | "other";
export interface CheckpointInfo {
    id: string;
    label: string;
    createdAt: string;
    trigger: CheckpointTrigger;
    files: number;
}
export interface ChangeEntry {
    path: string;
    status: ChangeStatus;
    kind: ChangeKind;
    untracked?: true;
    large?: true;
    diff?: string;
    blueprintDiff?: unknown;
    assetDiff?: AssetDiff;
}
export interface RestoreRefusal {
    path: string;
    reason: "edited-outside" | "not-recorded" | "write-failed";
    detail?: string;
}
export interface CheckpointState {
    editor: string;
    enabled: boolean;
    source: "config" | "session";
    configured: boolean;
    repository: string | null;
    checkpoints: CheckpointInfo[];
}
export interface CheckpointResult extends CheckpointInfo {
    editor: string;
    changes: ChangeEntry[];
    dirtyPackages: string[];
    editorConnected: boolean;
}
export interface ChangesResult {

    from: string;

    changes: ChangeEntry[];

        limit: number;
        diffed: number;
        deferred: string[];
    };
}
export interface NativeDiffResult {
    editor: string;
    path: string;

    tool?: string;
    revisions?: {
        before: {
            label: string;
            date: string;
        };
        after: {
            label: string;
            date: string;
        };
    };
    unloadsOnClose?: boolean;
    tempPackages?: string[];
}
export interface RestoreResult {
    editor: string;
    checkpoint: string;
    before: string;
    after: string;
    restored: Array<{
        path: string;
        action: "written" | "deleted";
    }>;
    refused: RestoreRefusal[];
    reloaded: string[];
    unloaded: string[];
    configsReloaded: string[];
    reopened: string[];
}
export interface AssetDiffRecord {
    displayString: string;
    diffType: string;
    category?: string;
    toolTip?: string;
    group?: string;
    hidden?: boolean;
    path?: string;
    label?: string;
    property?: string;
    before?: string | null;
    after?: string | null;
    graph?: string;
    node1?: AssetDiffNode;
    node2?: AssetDiffNode;
    pin1?: {
        name: string;
        direction: string;
        nodeGuid?: string;
        defaultValue: string;
        linkedTo: string[];
    };
    pin2?: {
        name: string;
        direction: string;
        nodeGuid?: string;
        defaultValue: string;
        linkedTo: string[];
    };
    properties?: AssetDiffRecord[];
    facts?: AssetFact[];
    treeLocation?: number[];
    owningObjectPath?: string;
    propertyDiffType?: string;
}
export interface AssetDiffNode {
    guid: string;
    name: string;
    class: string;
    title: string;
    fullTitle?: string;
    pins?: AssetDiffNodePin[];
    propertiesOf?: string;
    properties?: AssetDiffNodeProperty[];
    propertiesDropped?: number;
}
export interface AssetDiffNodePin {
    name: string;
    displayName: string;
    defaultValue: string;
    linked: boolean;
}
export interface AssetDiffNodeProperty {
    name: string;
    displayName: string;
    value: string;
    isDefault: boolean;
}
export interface AssetDiffSection {
    category: string;
    kind: "properties" | "graph" | "components";
    engineSource: string;
    entries: AssetDiffRecord[];
    hiddenChanges?: number;
    notes?: string[];
}
export interface AssetFact {
    name: string;
    value: string;
}
export type AssetThumbnail = {
    id: string;
    url: string;
    source: "rendered" | "saved" | "graph";
    note?: string;
    graph?: string;
} | {
    error: string;
};
export interface AssetVersion {
    class: string;
    objectName?: string;
    facts: AssetFact[];
    thumbnail?: AssetThumbnail;
    classThumbnail?: AssetThumbnail;
}
export interface AssetDiff {
    state: "ready" | "deferred" | "error";
    error?: string;
    packageName?: string;
    assetClass?: string;
    status?: "added" | "modified" | "deleted";
    engine?: {
        tool: string;
        note: string;
        native: "window" | "details" | "text";
        nativeAvailable?: boolean;
        nativeReason?: string;
        blueprintTypeDiff?: boolean;
    };
    before?: AssetVersion | null;
    after?: AssetVersion | null;
    classChanged?: string;
    sections?: AssetDiffSection[];
    textDiff?: {
        format: string;
        diff: string;
    };
    blueprint?: Record<string, unknown>;
    recordCount?: number;
    recordsDropped?: number;
    summary: string;
    nativeDiff: {
        available: boolean;
        reason?: string;
    };
}
export type DaemonSkillOwner = {
    kind: "ue-mcp";
    version: string;
} | {
    kind: "plugin";
    package: string;
    version: string | null;
} | {
    kind: "project";
};
export type ProjectSkillFolder = ".claude/skills" | ".agents/skills";
export interface ShadowedSkill {
    location: "packaged" | "project";
    folder?: ProjectSkillFolder;
    dir: string;
}
export interface DaemonSkill {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    description: string;
    dir: string;
    files: string[];
    body: string;
    frontmatter: Record<string, unknown>;
    tokens: number;
    owner: DaemonSkillOwner;
    location: "packaged" | "project";
    folder?: ProjectSkillFolder;
    shadows?: ShadowedSkill[];
    problems: string[];
}
export interface ContextProjectionOptions {
    strategy: ContextStrategy;
    categories?: string[];
}
export interface ProjectedTool {
    name: string;
    description: string;
    inputSchema: Record<string, unknown>;
    category: string | null;
}
export interface ContextProjection {
    strategy: ContextStrategy;
    categories: string[];
    instructions: string;
    tools: ProjectedTool[];
    seedTokens: number;
    estimator: "chars/4";
}
export interface ActionEffectInfo {
    category: string;
    action: string;
    effect: ActionEffect;
    effectSource: ActionEffectSource | "undeclared";
    destructive: boolean;
    destructiveSource: "declared" | "lexicon" | "none";
}
export type ContextScopeBucket = "1-3" | "4-8" | "9+";
export interface ContextMeasurementTask {
    id: string;
    totalTokens: number;
    modelCalls: number;
    discoveryCalls: number;
    passed: boolean;
}
export interface ContextMeasurementRun {
    model: {
        vendor: string;
        model: string;
    };
    scope: ContextScopeBucket;
    strategy: ContextStrategy;
    seedTokens: number;
    tasks: ContextMeasurementTask[];
}
export interface ContextMeasurement {
    version: 1;
    measuredAt: string;
    ueMcpVersion: string;
    client?: {
        name: string;
        version: string;
    };
    runs: ContextMeasurementRun[];
}
export type ContextMeasurementParse = {
    ok: true;
    value: ContextMeasurement;
} | {
    ok: false;
    errors: string[];
};
export interface FlowStepApprovalRequest {
    runId: string;
    flowName: string;
    task: string;
    phase: string;
    options: Record<string, unknown>;
    token: string;
}
export type FlowStepDecision = {
    allow: true;
} | {
    allow: false;
    reason?: string;
};
export type FlowStepApprover = (request: FlowStepApprovalRequest) => Promise<FlowStepDecision>;
export interface ExtensionManifest {
    name?: string;
    api?: {
        min?: number;
        max?: number;
    };
    ueMcp?: string;
    ui?: {
        min?: string;
        root?: boolean;
    };
}
export interface ExtensionRequest {
    method: string;
    path: string;
    params: Record<string, string>;
    query: Record<string, string>;
    headers: Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>;
    body: unknown;
}
export interface ExtensionResponse {
    status?: number;
    headers?: Record<string, string>;
    body?: unknown;
}
export type ExtensionHandler = (req: ExtensionRequest) => ExtensionResponse | undefined | Promise<ExtensionResponse | undefined>;
export interface CallActionOptions {
    dialogPrompt?: DialogPromptFn;
    dialogWaitMs?: number;
    elicit?: (params: ElicitParams) => Promise<ElicitResult>;
    access?: "read-write" | "read-only";
}
export interface ContextCallOptions extends CallActionOptions {
    strategy?: ContextStrategy;
    categories?: string[];
}
export interface ActionResult {
    isError: boolean;
    content: Array<{
        type: string;
        text?: string;
    }>;
}
export interface ExtensionServicesApi {
    provide(id: string, impl: unknown): () => void;
    get<T>(id: string): T | undefined;
    watch<T>(id: string, cb: (impl: T | undefined) => void): () => void;
}
export interface DaemonExtensionApi {
    apiVersion: number;
    version: string;
    projectDir: string;
    dataDir: string;
    events: {
        publish(type: string, data?: Record<string, unknown>): DaemonEvent;
        subscribe(listener: (e: DaemonEvent) => void): () => void;
        since(lastId: number): {
            events: DaemonEvent[];
            gap: boolean;
        };
    };
    route(method: "GET" | "POST" | "PUT" | "PATCH" | "DELETE", path: string, handler: ExtensionHandler): void;
    callAction(category: string, action: string, args?: Record<string, unknown>, opts?: CallActionOptions): Promise<ActionResult>;
    features?: readonly string[];
    nativeDialogs?: {
        list(): NativeDialogView[];
        press(hwnd: string, button: string, opts?: {
            pid?: number;
        }): Promise<NativeDialogPressResult>;
    };
    flows?: {
        approveSteps(approver: FlowStepApprover): () => void;
    };
    services?: ExtensionServicesApi;
    models?: {
        register(provider: ModelProvider): () => void;
    };
    checkpoints?: {
        state(opts?: {
            editor?: string;
            limit?: number;
        }): Promise<CheckpointState>;
        setEnabled(enabled: boolean | null, opts?: {
            editor?: string;
        }): Promise<CheckpointState>;
        create(label?: string, opts?: {
            editor?: string;
        }): Promise<CheckpointResult>;
        changes(from: string, to?: string, opts?: {
            editor?: string;
            assetDiffs?: boolean;
        }): Promise<ChangesResult>;
        assetDiff?(from: string, to: string | undefined, path: string, opts?: {
            editor?: string;
        }): Promise<AssetDiff>;
        thumbnail?(id: string, opts?: {
            editor?: string;
        }): {
            file: string;
            type: string;
        } | null;
        openNativeDiff?(path: string, from: string, to?: string, opts?: {
            editor?: string;
        }): Promise<NativeDiffResult>;
        restore(checkpoint: string, opts?: {
            paths?: string[];
            force?: boolean;
            editor?: string;
        }): Promise<RestoreResult>;
        clear(opts?: {
            editor?: string;
        }): Promise<{
            editor: string;
            cleared: true;
        }>;
    };
    skills?: {
        list(): DaemonSkill[];
    };
    context?: {
        project(opts: ContextProjectionOptions): ContextProjection;
        call(tool: string, input: Record<string, unknown>, opts?: ContextCallOptions): Promise<ActionResult>;
    };
    actions?: {
        effects(categories?: string[]): ActionEffectInfo[];
    };
    versions?(): {
        loaded: string;
        recorded: string | null;
        installed: string[];
    };
    editors(): EditorStatus[];
    editorOperation(op: "start" | "stop" | "restart" | "rebuild"): Promise<Record<string, unknown>>;
    setBusy(busy: () => boolean): void;
    ui: {
        trustKey(pem: string): void;
        install(dir: string): UiManifest;
        active(): UiManifest | null;
        own?(): UiManifest | null;
    };
    registryAccount(): Promise<{
        login: string;
        token: string;
        registry: string;
    } | null>;
    modes?: {
        get(): {
            feedback: {
                mode: "interactive" | "auto-approve" | "defer";
                project: boolean;
            };
            dialog: {
                mode: "interactive" | "auto" | "defer" | null;
                project: boolean;
            };
            playtest: {
                mode: "manual" | "automatic" | null;
                project: boolean;
            };
        };
        setFeedback(mode: "interactive" | "auto-approve" | "defer" | undefined): void;
        setDialog(mode: "interactive" | "auto" | "defer" | undefined): void;
        setPlaytest(mode: "manual" | "automatic" | undefined): void;
    };
    log: {
        info(message: string): void;
        warn(message: string, detail?: unknown): void;
    };
}
export interface DaemonExtension {
    activate(api: DaemonExtensionApi): void | {
        dispose?: () => void | Promise<void>;
    } | Promise<void | {
        dispose?: () => void | Promise<void>;
    }>;
}
export {};

export declare const parseContextMeasurement: (value: unknown) => ContextMeasurementParse;
export declare const readDiscovery: (projectDir: string) => DaemonDiscovery | null;
export declare const readLiveDiscovery: (projectDir: string, isAlive?: (pid: number) => boolean) => DaemonDiscovery | null;
export declare const scopeBucket: (categoryCount: number) => ContextScopeBucket;
export declare const signBundle: (dir: string, meta: { name: string; version: string; api: { min: number; max: number; }; module?: { entry: string; host: string; } | undefined; }, privateKeyPem: string) => UiManifest;
export declare const verifyBundle: (dir: string, trustedKeys: readonly KeyObject[] | ((name: string) => readonly KeyObject[])) => UiManifest;
